headline: Huawei found guilty of stealing trade secrets
summary: Huawei has been found guilty of stealing US trade secrets. A federal court jury in New York delivered the verdict. The ruling concludes a multi-year legal battle involving several companies.

summary: Take-Two issued a DMCA takedown for the GTA VI PC fan project 'Leonida'. The project aimed to translate a leaked Xbox build to PC. The 15-year-old creator's project has now been taken offline.

summary: GTA 6's first chapter is gaining praise for its immersive, slower pace. Fans are spending dozens of hours roleplaying within the initial section. The unique pacing offers a deep slice-of-life experience.

headline: Nuclear test veterans will get full truth, says Burnham, as he confirms independent panel
summary: Prime Minister Burnham confirms an independent panel for nuclear test veterans. The panel will investigate the health legacy of Britain's Cold War atomic program. Veterans are promised the 'full truth' regarding their service.

headline: Nuclear test veterans speak to BBC about search for justice
summary: Andy Burnham pledges 'the full truth' for nuclear test veterans. He confirmed an investigation into the health legacy of Britain's atomic program. Veterans continue their search for justice and recognition.

headline: Thomas Markle indicted by federal grand jury in US for possessing child sex abuse images
summary: Thomas Markle has been indicted by a federal grand jury in the US. He is accused of possessing child sex abuse images. The FBI arrested Markle on November 6 after a storage unit search.

headline: Third of young Brits have never had sex, but many are sexting and watching porn
summary: One-third of young people in Britain report never having had sex. Despite this, many are actively engaging in sexting. A significant number of young Brits also watch porn.
